status: Built only with --fix-grammar, which needs --official-hints (TXT-004, EXP-0093). Off by default: the release keeps the official text. Draft wording for user review.
description: Light grammar corrections of the US arcade's official English CONTINUE? hint pages (the 16 pages at MM.BIN records 0-15 under --official-hints, EXP-0086). Each fix names the official page it replaces by the SHA-256 of its decoded lines joined with a newline (tools.text.official_endings.en_cell_lines), so the official text is not copied here; the build refuses a page whose hash differs. Codes {01E2}-{01E8} are the joystick-arrow glyphs.
author: Claude (AI) draft from the official English; new text, not official.

hints.reason: Pages 0 and 1 are one sentence. The official line garbles "starting move"; "an Air Combo starter" says it in two words with the article.
The usual verb for the lever, and "them", since the opponent may be any character.
The official clause has no subject; "At Level 2 or higher" reads as intended.
The official line has no verb. "Cross-Over" is capitalised as on page 5.
